method: Paired local workerd runs; same machine, runtime, compatibility date, limits, payload, WebSocket clients and verifier. Synthetic isolated state; no deployments.
limits_note: Production message quotas preserved. Only WS connection admission is raised identically to 1000/min for fixture setup. No quota or authorization bypass in application code.
measurement: Warm connections and one warmup per writer; prebuilt equal-sized frames; queue-to-durable-ACK and queue-to-recipient WS arrival, not DOM. CPU: workerd process tree before/after measured sends. Peak RSS is process lifetime peak, not per-case allocation.
completion_note: Stopped after the first paired round demonstrated SEND_QUEUE_FULL in TypeScript; not included in bounded comparison medians.
